name: Snagwrath
description: Open with a jab from each sai in turn so the opponent must choose which hand to answer.

name: Impenetrable Handknob
description: Perch the sai point-up beside each shoulder like a hawk on a post and shed cuts from either side.

name: Phantom Hiltpoint
description: Moving on the balls of both feet brings the pair of sai in without a sound.

name: Prongvigil
description: Watch the opponent's shadow between the two sai and know which foot will carry the lunge.

name: Torrent Tineright
description: Fan the sai like pinions and scatter a volley of thrusts to both sides.

name: Webbing Sidehook
description: Lock the sai crossways round a blade so it rests between them like a captured bird.

name: Pinionruin
description: Rap the knobs of both sai along arm and shoulder and jaw in a quick rising line.

name: Ponderous Clasp
description: Stoop on a weapon arm with both sai and close the tines until the whole limb is held in place.

name: Mangling Centerprong
description: Both prongs strike the same plate at once so the field splits the seam wide open.

name: Twistflash
description: Vanish from before the opponent's guard and reappear beside the sword arm with both prongs set.

name: Wristwrath
description: Start both prongs together from one shoulder line like two springs feeding a single river.

name: Invincible Sanguard
description: Meet a heavy cut where both crossbars join so the force is split between the arms.

name: Silt Crossprong
description: Pivot on a planted foot as water bends round a sandbar and leave the blow behind.

name: Lacerating Prongbase
description: Skim both prongs along a blade's flat and into the gap above the opponent's guard.

name: Remnant Tinecrook
description: Rest both tines on the opponent's weapon and feel the current of the arm behind it.

name: Strangling Snag
description: Meander the sai in a slow S-curve round a weapon until the tines close behind its guard.

name: Equipoise Hiltpoint
description: Set both sai like a weir so a rushing attack spills sideways over the lower tine.

name: Twistnerve
description: Hook both side tines under the opponent's wrists and drag down and apart in an undertow.

name: Suffocating Ensnare
description: Run two streams of qi through the crossed forks to bind a weapon and its wielder's arm together.

name: Pinionhavoc
description: Hold both sai taut and then loose the stored force in one double strike that breaks a guard.

name: Grave Centerprong
description: Overflow the field through both prongs so the strike passes the layers of armor and cloth over the target.

name: Obdurate Tineleft
description: Raise both sai as mirrors before the brow and take a high cut on crossed tines.

name: Unbudging Tineright
description: Check a shoulder-high swing with the lead sai while the rear sai covers behind it.

name: Meridian Hiltpoint
description: Settle the breath through the whole meridian network until the grip is as steady as a post.

name: Punishing Sidehook
description: Let the double guard take the cut and rap the knobs of both sai into the exposed wrist.

name: Immobilizing Prongbase
description: Lock a blade between four tines and let the meridian network carry the strain instead of the arms.

name: Chimeprong
description: Turn both sai on the line of a heavy blow so its weight slides along the shafts and away.

name: Flintlike Handknob
description: Close a circuit of qi between the two sai so the guard becomes a ring that turns to meet each strike.

name: Shade Wrest
description: Close both forks on a weapon arm and crush it with network-borne force until it lies still.

name: Glintvee
description: Return the full weight of a Monarch-strength blow through both prongs into the one who struck it.

name: Vengeful Crossprong
description: Fan three jabs from the pair of sai in one breath to divide the opponent's guard.

name: Unassailable Sanguard
description: Hold both tines on the line of sight so any cut toward the face must cross metal first.

name: Prongglare
description: Step in from the side as a tributary joins a river and arrive on the opponent's flank.

name: Might Sidehook
description: Scatter small raps from both knobs across wrist and shoulder and ribs to keep the guard jumping.

name: Illuminating Tineleft
description: Sweep the field across the whole distance and pick out the one hand that will strike first.

name: Adamantine Tinecrook
description: Split a flurry between the two sai so each hand turns half the stream and neither tires.

name: Harnessing Twist
description: Catch two weapons at once with a sai on each and hold them crossed against one another.

name: Facet Hiltpoint
description: Answer one cut with prongs thrust at several seams of the armor within the same breath.

name: Claspruin
description: Fix the hawk's gaze on one point of the body and land every blow on it until it gives way.

name: Overlapping Tineright
description: Chain a catch and a cut and a thrust from alternating sai so each opens the way for the next.

name: Charter Wrest
description: Cast the field round the two sai in a sphere that holds a trapped weapon arm from any motion.

name: Indomitable Shade Handknob
description: Spread an incoming force into many small streams that the field swallows before they reach the body.

name: Clasphavoc
description: Send the low sai along the floor track at the shin while the high sai holds the eyes.

name: Unrelenting Centerprong
description: Lift the high sai overhead while the low sai guards the belly in the same instant.

name: Blinding Snag
description: A quick step changes tracks so the high sai becomes the low and the low becomes the high.

name: Hellish Prongbase
description: Skip the butt-knobs one after the other off a long weapon's guard and into the hand behind it.

name: Prescient Crossprong
description: Run the field along both tracks at once to find which of them the opponent has left open.

name: Mayhem Pinion
description: Lock a blade on both tracks of the pair and pull the weapon along the longer of them.

name: Unbowed Sidehook
description: Weave a parry high with one sai and low with the other so no cut finds a gap between them.

name: Twisthavoc
description: Climb a stair of raps from ankle to temple on alternate hands without a pause.

name: Hogtying Wrest
description: Hook the opponent's own track as it opens and tie its weapon to the other sai.

name: Multiplying Clasp
description: Link eight strokes of both sai in a chain that rolls from basin floor to high azure without a break.

name: Snagscourge
description: Raise the high sai to the zenith and drive it through the guard in a single drop.

name: Toxin Tinecrook
description: Plant the low sai crossed in the ground and cast qi along the track so an advancing foot trips on it.

name: Eviscerating Glint Pinion
description: Strike high and low in one instant so no guard can answer both and either prong may land the finish.

name: Rampaging Handknob
description: Rise from a crouch on an updraft of breath and drive both prongs at the throat.

name: Ironprong
description: Fold the tines in like talons about a branch and let a strong cut break over them.

name: Meteoric Tineleft
description: Glide in along a long low line and rise inside the reach of the opponent's weapon.

name: Unerring Centerprong
description: Watch the glint of the opponent's steel against the sun and tell the moment of the cut.

name: Evergreen Hiltpoint
description: Beat the sai down like wings and turn a chain of cuts aside with every beat.

name: Hoarfrost Ensnare
description: Seize an arm between the four tines like prey in a grip and hold it before it can pull free.

name: Wristscourge
description: Tear down the length of a shoulder with both tines at once on the way past.

name: Overpowering Pinion
description: Fall from a height with both sai spread and clamp the opponent's shoulders to the ground.

name: Nova Prongbase
description: Plunge both prongs from above in one stroke that punches through a helm and a shoulder plate.

name: Veedurance
description: Catch the point of a technique between both forks at its first instant and let the field smother its force.

name: Wrestwrath
description: Jab from a stance rooted like a stone on the high plateau.

name: Thorn Sanguard
description: Hold the crossbar to the oath that no cut shall pass it and take the blow on set tines.

name: Granite Crossprong
description: Step up into the wind rather than away so the opponent's force is spent against it.

name: Impervious Tineleft
description: Roll the prong under a gust of cuts and let each one slide up the shaft and off.

name: Vigilant Hiltpoint
description: Read the line the opponent means to take from the lean of the shoulders and the set of the hips.

name: Mastering Snag
description: Roll the prong round a weapon's hilt until the guard locks against the fork.

name: Honed Tinecrook
description: Hold the line against a charge and let the opponent's own advance drive onto the prong.

name: Maiming Clasp
description: Sweep the tines in a sudden gust under the hilt and lift the weapon from the hand.

name: Decimating Wrest
description: Roll prong after prong along one sworn line until the opponent cannot advance a step.

name: Inexorable Prongbase
description: Hold an unbroken guard line across the plateau while qi runs steadily through crossbar and tines.

name: Pinionscourge
description: Drive the central prong along the sworn line with the whole field behind it and break the strongest guard there.

name: Numbing Pinion
description: Take a bearing on the incoming blade and close the fork on it.

name: Indomitable Crossprong
description: Hold the crossbar on its heading against a driving cut so it does not drift.

name: Wristblink
description: Take one slanting step along a fresh bearing and let the driving attack pass.

name: Pitiless Tineright
description: Answer a driving cut with the fork against its flat and the knob into the ribs.

name: Unconquered Handknob
description: Correct the drift of a swerving blade with a small turn of the wrist and take it wide.

name: Chime Snag
description: Spiral the fork round a blade from guard to point and peel it from the grip.

name: Verity Sanguard
description: Hold the heading until the attack peaks and then return its force down the same line.

name: Overbearing Clasp
description: Cast the field across the fork in a net that catches every weapon sent along the bearing.

name: Intentwrest
description: Close the fork on a blade and seal its energy so the weapon is dead steel until the catch opens.

name: Ruinous Tineleft
description: Jab with the off hand held open and the bearing already fixed on the opponent's centre.

name: Adamantine Sanguard
description: Hold both sai wide apart so a cut must cross a broad span of guard to land.

name: Dazzling Handknob
description: Take a long low stride across open ground and close the distance before the opponent adjusts.

name: Vessel Crossprong
description: Speak the oath silently on the breath and let the meridian network settle round the grip.

name: Veeruin
description: Rap the butt-knob across the line of a swing and knock the wrist off its bearing.

name: Inexorable Tineright
description: Sweep both sai in a wide arc so a run of cuts is swept from the line one by one.

name: Harnessing Pinion
description: A gust of network qi snaps the tines closed on a blade and holds it hard.

name: Strangling Clasp
description: Slide a tine under the hilt and lift the weapon away before the wielder can renew the grip.

name: Snagruin
description: Return along the same bearing a cut arrived on and thrust the prong into its source.

name: Prongspine
description: Run network qi in a circuit through both sai so the open guard turns hard against any blow.

name: Overbearing Twist
description: Press both sai flat on a weapon arm with the whole network behind them until it stills.

name: Equipoise Tinecrook
description: Stand unshaken as a technique arrives and let the held oath unmake its force at the fork.

name: Wrathful Prongbase
description: Jab across the direction of an attack so the prong arrives from the side it cannot guard.

name: Unbowed Crossprong
description: Set the tines edge-on to a cut so it parts round them like air round a post.

name: Torrent Tinecrook
description: Cross one foot over the other to leave the line of a charge and come back along its flank.

name: Clairvoyant Tineleft
description: Feel the push of air on the tines to learn the weight and speed of a swing before it lands.

name: Pinionnerve
description: Close the fork on a blade from the side instead of the front and wrench it round.

name: Wrestscourge
description: Veer off a lunge and rake the tines across the exposed forearm as the weapon goes past.

name: Obdurate Prongbase
description: Throw the tines up in a gale of motion and send three quick cuts wide in a row.

name: Blistering Crossprong
description: Drive across a guard's weaker side with the field pressed behind the prong until it yields.

name: Webbing Ensnare
description: Hold a caught weapon on a steady line while the field leans against it like a constant wind.

name: Novaclasp
description: Vanish across the wind of an attack and cut from the side where the opponent last looked.

name: Pinionwrath
description: Jab the central prong from a stance planted on the very edge of the footing.

name: Flintlike Sanguard
description: Cover the body with centre prong and both tines so a cut from any angle meets metal.

name: Lightning Hiltpoint
description: Move along the narrow line of the edge without a wasted pace or a glance at the drop.

name: Twistwrath
description: Flick a side tine up across the eyes and follow with the butt-knob to the ribs.

name: Aura Tineright
description: Read the updraft along the plateau edge to judge how the opponent's footing will fail.

name: Overpowering Ensnare
description: Catch a blade on the left tine and take the guard on the right so the weapon is trapped between them.

name: Shattering Tineleft
description: Meet a straight thrust with the centre prong and slide it round to pierce the arm behind.

name: Unassailable Centerprong
description: Drag a blade along the tines so the wind of its own swing carries it off.

name: Hogtying Pinion
description: Spin the sai about a spear shaft so the hilt guard is wrenched from the hand.

name: Reverberating Clasp
description: Cascade strokes of centre prong then left tine then right tine in a cycle that gives no rest.

name: Septic Prongbase
description: Plant the sai crossed along the lip of the footing so a stumbling foot catches in the tines.

name: Blaze Twist
description: Push the field outward from all three prongs in a broad gust that drives every nearby foe back.

name: Titanic Wrest Havoc
description: Sweep the plateau edge with all three prongs and a long field that clears the whole line of guards.

name: Ferocious Tinecrook
description: Fix the long bearing first and jab along it without a second glance at the target.

name: Wristmettle
description: Hold the fork steady in a hard wind and let each cut break upon it in turn.

name: Ghosting Prongbase
description: Shift the feet without changing the bearing so the sai never leave the line.

name: Lacerating Handknob
description: Lift the fork underhand beneath a chin and snap the head back with the knob.

name: Veeinsight
description: Hold still on the bearing and feel how the wind of each swing leans on the fork.

name: Fastening Snag
description: Let the fork bend around a swinging weapon as wind bends round a tree and hold it fast.

name: Twistscourge
description: Counter along the whole length of the long bearing and drive the prong through the guard.

name: Impenetrable Tineright
description: Turn the fork a half circle against the push of a blade and send it past the shoulder.

name: Intent Pinion
description: Pin a weapon with the fork and hold it unyielding while the field bears down on the arm behind it.

name: Punishing Crossprong
description: Advance slowly on one bearing through a storm of cuts and then lance the prong through the guard.

name: Thornprong
description: Take a mighty blow into the fork and let the field bend its force round the body into the air.
